judge_reasoning: All candidates directly answer the prompt by giving fictional extraterrestrials from planet Zog with both appearance and behavior, but they vary in specificity and coherence. Candidate [2] is also detailed but leans more heavily on broad sci-fi tropes (e.g., extreme sensory claims and mental effects) with slightly less grounded connective tissue between sections.
